purpose: Actual human target-reader post-change validation of the revised YMGQ candidate. Determine whether the five still-open human reader failures are materially improved/closed on the new SHA. This is not an AI architecture test.

pass_H1.name: current-version immersion read
pass_H1.instruction: Read the current manuscript from beginning to end without opening repair reports, Phase361 analysis, or the old failure ledger during the read. Record spontaneous skim/stop points, desire-to-continue, strongest and weakest sections, dialogue naturalness, suspense pull, climax experience, and whether the manuscript feels lived or mechanically constructed.

pass_H2.name: targeted closure check
pass_H2.instruction: After H1 is frozen, review the five prior human failure classes and judge each on the new SHA as CLOSED / MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT_BUT_OPEN / STILL_FAILING, with located reasons.

next_after_completion: Coordinator binds the human validation report/result to manuscript SHA 82c05523... and decides whether failures close, whether one bounded repair remains necessary, or whether the manuscript becomes final-freeze eligible.
